audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Caitlyn's W 'Yordle Snap Traps' (plural) — the real ability name is singular, 'Yordle Snap Trap', per enemyAbilities.W. It recurs in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[5].t, report[9].t and content wants.foe[0] (the last flagged directly by the linter).
audit.why: A wrong ability name is exactly the class of error the project calibration singles out (Brand's R, Cassiopeia's Q). Readers who search the real ability name won't recognize the page, and it undercuts trust in the rest of the sequencing advice.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence corrected to singular 'Yordle Snap Trap'.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed (verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles), several fields misgender Caitlyn as he/him, and breakdown.cooldowns has no digit.
audit.why: Caitlyn is she/her; the owner is 'you' so third-person pronouns name the enemy. Bled bullets don't deliver what their titles promise.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed across tldr, tradeGood, phases[0].why, phases[1].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten with kit-grounded content (Q rev-up tell, E's knockback recoil). breakdown.cooldowns now carries the real W recast time (0.5s) and E cooldown (16/14/12/10/8s).
